Implemented e2e helper de-duplication across three batches, preserving each call site's exact behavior where the "duplicates" actually diverged.

**B1: shared `tests/e2e/workflow-helpers.ts`, 3 specs converted** (electrical-workflow, installation-workflow, app-confirmation). Review note: the four "verbatim" card helpers were **not** verbatim — installation carried bounded 10s mount waits and a Mission-warehouse preference that electrical lacked. Per the preservation rule, the shared versions default to the defensive behavior and parameterize the divergence: `mountTimeoutMs` (default 10s; electrical passes `0` to keep its original instant no-op checks — Playwright reads `timeout:0` as infinite, so 0 is handled explicitly), and `preferredWarehouseName` (installation passes `"Mission"`, its rationale comment moved to the call site; electrical keeps first-option). `scrollUntilVisible` defaults to `attempts: 12` (most defensive, documented). `screenshotName`, `toLabelRegex`, `attachStepScreenshot`, `uploadRequiredPhotoByLabel`, and `ONE_BY_ONE_PNG` shared verbatim. Out-of-scope locals (`saveCurrentCardAndWait` — behaviorally different, `cardHeaderRegex`, app-confirmation's `ONE_BY_ONE_PNG`) untouched.

**B2: 4/4 specs converted** (change-order-workflow, payments, solar-commission-ppw-override, tax-mode-invoice) to `resolvePdftotext` up front + `test.skip` when null + `pdfToText`, matching payment-invoice-generation/project-invoice-deposits. tax-mode keeps `PDFTOPPM` local (different binary, not covered by the shared module); orphan `execFileSync`/`existsSync` imports removed.

**B3: done, no variant kept** — the remote-signing difference was structural, not behavioral (plain `Page` vs `FrameLocator` ceremony root, SYNC_TIMEOUT identical at 45_000 everywhere). Shared `drawOnPad`/`signEverything` now take `scope: Page | FrameLocator` and `drawOnPad` is exported; agreement-sign imports `signEverything` (its local `drawOnPad` had no other caller); remote-signing pass
